title: Protocol for the isolation of mouse senescence-associated CD4+ T cells using flow cytometry and functional assays
protocol: Sacrifice two mice by CO2 asphyxiation.
Spray the sacrificed mice entirely with alcohol disinfectant.
Collect the spleens in a sterile hood.
Place the collected spleens in a 70 μm cell strainer on a 6 cm petri dish filled with 5 mL FACS buffer.
Mash the spleens with the plunger end of a sterile 1 mL syringe.
Grasp the cell strainer using a tweezer and wash the suspension in the strainer with an additional 5 mL FACS buffer.
Transfer the total 10 mL of suspension to a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge at 350 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Briefly dissociate the cell pellet by tapping the tube and suspend the cells thoroughly in 2 mL ACK lysis buffer.
Incubate the suspension for 2 min at 20°C–25°C.
Add 10 mL FACS buffer, mix by inversion.
Centrifuge at 350 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Suspend the cells in 5 mL anti-CD16/32 Ab (diluted 2.4G2 hybridoma culture supernatant).
Incubate the mixture for 15 min at 4°C.
Centrifuge at 350 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Label CD4+ T cells with anti-CD4 magnetic beads.
Dilute 200 μL of CD4 MicroBeads with MACS buffer to a final volume of 2 mL.
Suspend the cells with the diluted beads and incubate for 30 min at 4°C.
Add 10 mL of MACS buffer, mix by inversion, and centrifuge at 350 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Suspend the cells in 1 mL of MACS buffer.
Place an LS column (Miltenyi) in the magnetic field of the MACS separator.
Rinse the column with 3 mL of MACS buffer.
Transfer the cell suspension to the column.
Wash the column twice with 3 mL of MACS buffer.
Remove the column from the magnet and place it on a 15 mL conical tube.
Flush out the labeled CD4+ cells with 5 mL of MACS buffer.
Centrifuge at 350 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Stain the cells with Abs in 300 μL of either staining panel A or B containing all required Abs (1:200 dilution with FACS buffer).
Incubate for 20 min in the dark at 4°C.
Add 10 mL FACS buffer, mix by inversion and centrifuge at 350 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and suspend the cells in 1–2 mL FACS buffer.
Filter the cell suspension through a 35 μm strainer cap into a 5 mL polystyrene tube.
Keep on ice.
Set up a flow cytometer according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Check the cytometer performance with CS&T beads.
Determine the drop delay using Accudrop beads.
Prepare 10 mL culture medium into 15 mL conical tubes for collection.
Coat the whole surface inside the tube with the medium.
Place the 15 mL conical tubes on the two-way 15 mL collection device.
Immediately before loading, add a 1/200 volume of 100 μg/mL PI to the sample tube and vortex it to stain dead cells.
Load the sample tube containing the cells stained with panel A.
Sort CD153+ SA-T cells (CD153+ PD-1+ CD44hi CD4+ B220– CD11b–) into a collection tube.
Simultaneously, sort PD-1– CD44hi cells (CD153– PD-1– CD44hi CD4+ B220– CD11b–) into another collection tube.
Load the sample tube containing the cells stained with panel B.
Sort the enriched CD153+ SA-T cells (Lag3+ CD121b– CD25– PD-1+ CD44hi CD4+ B220– CD11b–) into a collection tube.
Simultaneously, sort PD-1– CD44hi (Lag3– CD121b– CD25–) cells (PD-1– CD44hi Lag3– CD121b– CD25– CD4+ B220– CD11b–) into another collection tube.
Set the sample temperature control at 4°C.
Sort a sufficient number of cells (if possible, at least 1.5 times more cells than needed).
Confirm successful sorting by reloading an aliquot and confirming cell plotting within or close to the target gate.
Take note of the “total sort count” displayed on the Sort Layout Window.
Bring Ab-coated culture plate from 4°C to room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Centrifuge the sorted cells.
Centrifuge the sorted cells at 350 × g for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Repeat centrifugation for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant again to remove any remaining liquid.
Suspend the cells in culture medium to an estimated concentration of 2 × 10^6 cells/mL based on the total sort count.
Take 10 μL of cell suspension and mix it with 10 μL Trypan Blue Stain (0.4%) by pipetting.
Inject 10 μL of the mixed cell suspension into a hemocytometer.
Count the unstained alive cells under a microscope to calculate the actual concentration of the cells.
Adjust the concentration to 1 × 10^6 cells/mL by adding culture medium as needed.
Initiate stimulation with Abs.
Dilute anti-CD28 Ab 1:250 in culture medium.
Aspirate coating solution and PBS from the Ab-coated plate using a 10 μL tip.
Add 50 μL of 2× anti-CD28 Ab solution to the corresponding wells.
Add 50 μL of culture medium to other corresponding wells.
Add 50 μL of cell suspension to each well, making a total volume of 100 μL per well.
Incubate the plate at 37°C in a humidified 5% CO2 incubator for 3 days.
Harvest cells and supernatant after 72-hour incubation.
Suspend cultured cells by gentle pipetting using a multichannel pipette.
Transfer suspended cells to a 96-well round bottom plate.
Centrifuge the plate at 400 × g for 5 minutes.
Collect 70-80 μL/well of supernatant and store in aliquots at -80°C.
Briefly vortex remaining cells on the bottom of the plate to dissociate pellets.
Add 100 μL FACS buffer to the wells.
Observe the cells under a microscope before harvesting.
Wash the cells with FACS buffer.
Centrifuge the plate at 400 × g for 2 min.
Discard the supernatant by quickly inverting the plate.
Briefly vortex the plate.
Add 100 μL FACS buffer.
Repeat washing and centrifuging steps.
Stain the dead cells with 50 μL FVD780 (1:1,000 dilution).
Incubate the plate for 20 min at 4°C in the dark.
Wash the cells with FACS buffer again.
Fix and permeabilize the cells.
Add 50 μL Fixation/Permeabilization buffer to the wells.
Gently vortex the plate for 10 seconds.
Incubate the plate at 4°C in the dark for 30 minutes.
Mix 1 volume of Concentrate with 3 volumes of Diluent to prepare Fixation/Permeabilization buffer prior to use.
Wash the cells with 1× Permeabilization buffer (1:10 dilution with distilled water).
Centrifuge the plate at 400 × g for 2 minutes and discard the supernatant.
Briefly vortex the plate.
Add 100 μL of 1× Permeabilization buffer to the wells.
Repeat steps a and b for another round of washing and permeabilizing.
Stain intracellular Ki67 by adding 50 μL APC-labeled anti-Ki67 Ab (1:200 dilution with 1× Permeabilization buffer).
Incubate the plate at 20°C–25°C in the dark for 30 minutes.
Wash the cells with 1× Permeabilization buffer as described in step 26.
Wash the cells with FACS buffer as described in step 22.
Suspend the cells in 150 μL FACS buffer and filter them through a 37 μm nylon mesh into a 5 mL polystyrene tube.
Load samples on the CantoII flow cytometer.
Assess the frequency of Ki67+ cells.
Coat a 96-well Nunc Maxisorp plate with an anti-OPN capture antibody included in the ELISA kit.
Add 50 μL/well of a working dilution of the capture Ab to the plate.
Seal the plate with a plate seal and incubate it at 20°C–25°C for 16–20 hours.
Wash the plate with 400 μL/well of ELISA washing buffer three times.
Remove the remaining buffer by blotting the inverted plate against paper towels.
Block the plate with 300 μL/well of 1% BSA-PBS.
Incubate for 1 hour at 20°C–25°C during blocking.
Dilute supernatant samples with 1% BSA-PBS; prepare 110 μL or more for each sample.
Make 2-fold serial dilutions of rmOPN with 1% BSA-PBS according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Wash the plate as in step 33.
Add 50 μL/well of the samples and standards.
Cover the plate with a plate seal.
Incubate for 2 h at 20°C–25°C.
Wash the plate as in step 33.
Add 50 μL/well of a working dilution of the biotinylated detection Ab (included in the kit).
Cover the plate with a plate seal.
Incubate it for 2 h at 20°C–25°C.
Wash the plate four times as in step 33.
Add 50 μL/well of a working dilution of horseradish peroxidase-streptavidin (included in the kit).
Cover the plate with a plate seal.
Incubate it for 20 min in the dark at 20°C–25°C.
Wash the plate five times as in step 33.
Add 50 μL/well of TMB solution.
Cover the plate with a plate seal.
Incubate it for 20 min or less in the dark at 20°C–25°C.
Prior to use, bring the TMB solution to room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Add 50 μL/well of 1 M H2SO4.
Mix it with a gentle tapping to stop the reaction.
Wear protective gloves and carefully use H2SO4 as it is caustic.
Measure the optical density at 450 nm using a microplate reader such as the Sunrise Microplate Reader.
For correction, subtract the readings at 620 nm from those at 450 nm.
Average the duplicate readings for each sample and standard.
Make a standard curve and calculate the concentration of OPN in the samples.
